subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers land the linked fork cleanup PR, replace it with a same-repo cleanup PR, or close that candidate and leave this issue for later?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open fork PR already owns the proposed cleanup path and needs human review or replacement before ClawSweeper should queue another fix.

options.title: Review or replace the linked cleanup PR
options.body: Treat the open fork PR as the current candidate and either land it after proof/refresh or replace it with an equivalent same-repo branch.

options.title: Close the candidate but keep the issue
options.body: If the fork branch is not usable, close the candidate PR while keeping this issue as the canonical source-reproducible bug.

options.title: Defer placeholder cleanup
options.body: Leave the issue open without active implementation if maintainers want to sequence this behind broader Google Chat delivery work.

recommendation.title: Review or replace the linked cleanup PR
recommendation.body: Treat the open fork PR as the current candidate and either land it after proof/refresh or replace it with an equivalent same-repo branch.

likelyOwner.reason: This person recently worked on the Google Chat reply-delivery path where the cleanup belongs.
